titulo: The customer who leaves you on read
hooks: When you send the price and they vanish
The mystery customer who never comes back
POV: you sent the quote over text

mensajes.texto: Hi, how much for a full timing belt job?
Hi Luke. It's this much with OEM parts and a warranty.
Great, let me talk it over with my wife
Sure, let me know if you have any questions.
Hi Luke, did you get a chance to talk it over?
She hasn't gotten back to me yet

contenido.remate: His wife is still thinking it over

captions: Sending cold quotes over text almost always ends with you on read. When you have a clear website explaining your services, the customer already knows what you do before reaching out.
The classic 'I'll let you know after I talk it over at home.' If your business had a website with photos of your work and how you operate, inquiries would come in a lot more solid.
For everyone still waiting on that reply since last year.
